headline: Claim Devaughn Vele (bid 3) for Wednesday's 12:05 AM PT run, then move A.J. Brown to IR Tuesday morning once he unlocks — no other lineup moves needed, everything else is locked.
summary: Week 1 is essentially over for Danny: only Waddle's Monday-night game at KC is still to be played, and he's already correctly starting. The one real move is banking A.J. Brown's IR spot Tuesday morning and using it on a cheap, speculative waiver claim rather than any lineup change.

adds.why: Tier 3, bid 3 of your 150: a week-1 breakout behind the season's biggest crowd (bid the tier, not the box score), but it costs nothing since A.J. Brown's Tuesday IR move frees the roster spot.
adds.evidence: Vele caught 7 of 9 targets for 69 yards and a TD Sun Sept 13 vs DET, clear No. 2 in New Orleans behind Chris Olave with Jordyn Tyson (WR3) out (NBC Sports, Sept 13); on waivers here, 803K leaguewide adds in 48h. A.J. Brown, whose roster spot this uses, was placed on IR by New England with a high ankle sprain, out into Week 6 (Boston.com/Rapoport, Sept 11-13), so his spot opens Tuesday morning without a drop needed.

ir.why: High ankle sprain, placed on IR by New England (reported Sept 11-13), expected out into Week 6 at the earliest. He's LOCKED until this week's games complete Tuesday morning, so the move has to wait until then; it frees his roster spot for the Vele claim and his WR slot, which Khalil Shakir should fill starting Week 2.
